# PPMANI — Freelance Web Developer

## About

PPMANI is a professional freelance web developer based in India, offering custom website design and development services to businesses across India and worldwide. Specialises in fast, responsive, and SEO-friendly websites with delivery in as little as 48 hours.

## Services

- Business website design and development
- Landing page design and development
- Website redesign and modernisation
- Frontend performance optimisation
- Responsive mobile-first web development

## Expertise

- Frontend technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
- Responsive and mobile-first design
- SEO-friendly website architecture
- Fast-loading, performance-optimised builds
- Hosted on modern platforms (Netlify, Vercel)
